name: Unarmored Defense (Barbarian)
source: SRD 5.1 Barbarian: 10 + DEX + CON while wearing no armor; a shield still applies

name: Unarmored Defense (Monk)
source: SRD 5.1 Monk: 10 + DEX + WIS while wearing no armor and not wielding a shield

name: Mage Armor
source: SRD 5.1 spell Mage Armor: base AC 13 + DEX on a creature not wearing armor
